source.event: Planning application put on public display
source.status: planned, subject to permits and contracts; not operating observations

evidence_gaps: Hourly IT load and marginal heat demand at a shared delivery boundary
Temperature-dependent heat-pump COP, capacity and parasitic load measurements
Signed heat-source price, electricity tariff and allocation of investment costs
Equipment and connection quotes; commissioning, ramp-up and outage assumptions
limitations: All economics and operating profiles are synthetic; not a valuation of Bulle
Monthly flat simultaneous profiles overstate matching relative to unresolved intra-month variability; no storage
COP includes assumed heat-pump electrical input only; other incremental auxiliaries must enter costs or an effective COP
Existing supply fixed costs remain sunk; only displaced marginal heat cost is avoided
Server electricity and server CAPEX are unchanged in both options and excluded
No minimum-load, temperature, network capacity, reliability or hydraulic model
Repeated steady-state 8760-hour year; no escalation, tax, financing, degradation, subsidies, residual value or construction delay
No emissions benefit computed; the actual district network is already predominantly renewable
